#A Private Harbor Cruise on the Best Catamaran Yacht in San Diego!

##Schedule
Monday - Sunday
Year Round

Triton Charters is San Diego’s largest and newest Catamaran. Our yacht can accommodate up to 100 guests and is perfect for group events. We specialize in weddings, bachelorette/bachelor parties, birthday bashes, family/friend outings, corporate events and much more! Triton presents a modern aesthetic with spacious open seating, an advanced 13-seat bar, a vibrant dance floor, and even includes a built-in water slide. We thought of everything to make your group outing perfect, so you don’t have to!
